content: Drizzle ORM (npm latest 0.45.2) is code-first, SQL-close, edge-native, small bundle, runs near raw-SQL performance; best fit for serverless/edge deploys. Prisma 7 rewrote its query engine to TS/Wasm (~600KB gzipped, down from binary engine) closing much of the gap but still more abstraction/generation-step overhead than Drizzle.
